info.title: Device Control Service API
info.description: API for managing sensors in the Warm House System. This service provides endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting sensors, along with health monitoring capabilities using FastAPI and SQLModel.

get.description: Returns the current status of the device control service. This endpoint is used for health monitoring and service discovery.
Retrieve a paginated list of all sensors in the system. Supports offset and limit parameters for pagination.

post.description: Create a new sensor in the system. The sensor will be initialized with default values for status, timestamps, and temperature reading from the external temperature service.

get.description: Retrieve a specific sensor by its unique identifier.

delete.description: Delete a sensor from the system permanently. This action cannot be undone.
